analyst_view.overall: Nordsjaelland (25th, 2 pts) host Panathinaikos (2nd, 9 pts from 3 wins): the Danes need a win to climb into the top 24, while Panathinaikos are close to a top-eight place. Nordsjaelland are 4th in Denmark and have been scoring freely (6-1 at Randers), form the numbers barely see because Danish league stats are not in the model, and their European games have been open (2-2 with CSKA). Panathinaikos, under Jacob Neestrup, beat OFI 2-0 on Sunday but lost Santino Andino to a torn ACL for the season; the numbers already count him, Ounahi and Ingason. They don't count new worries: centre-back Stefan de Vrij was hurt in the same game and left-back Salah-Eddine was ill, both missing Monday's training while the club awaits tests. No referee has been named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals, split 1.6 to 1.2, already taking off Andino, Ounahi and Ingason for Panathinaikos. I lean a little higher: de Vrij and Salah-Eddine are doubts in Panathinaikos' back line, which the numbers can't see, and Nordsjaelland's free-scoring league form is invisible to the model too. +5% gives about 2.8 goals.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners, split evenly. Both sides like the ball and the numbers already reflect their corner records; losing Andino, a winger, may cut Panathinaikos' wide play a little, but that is already part of his counted absence, so I stay at about 9.8.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards and already add about 10% for Panathinaikos' recent bookings. A reshuffled Panathinaikos defence may have to foul more against Nordsjaelland's quick attack, but that is a guess and no referee is named yet, so I stay at about 4.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.0 shots, a little below a usual game and already raised 5% for Nordsjaelland's recent volume. Nordsjaelland's home attack should push that up, but a Panathinaikos side keeping the ball can slow the game, so I stay at about 26.0.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.6 shots on target, already nudged up for both sides' recent accuracy. Nordsjaelland's sharp finishing in the league and a Panathinaikos back line that may be missing de Vrij, neither of which the numbers can see, point slightly higher: +3% gives about 9.9.
